scenarios.hypothesis: A lower-authority data value is concatenated into a derived expression string and reparsed as expression source under a stronger evaluation context.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled synthetic arithmetic/string marker and read-only render sink reveal whether reparsing occurred without invoking any external capability or system effect.
scenarios.positive_control: The same literal expression supplied through an explicitly authorized expression-source field evaluates to the expected synthetic marker under the documented policy.
scenarios.negative_control: The same lower-authority value kept as a plain variable remains literal data and is rendered without expression evaluation or helper invocation.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would invoke process execution, access real secrets/files, pivot network access, establish persistence, or leave the local owned sandbox.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After separating source construction from data binding, the lower-authority value remains data while explicitly authorized source continues to evaluate normally.
scenarios.principal_source_data_generation: Record principal/tenant, render transaction, template trust class, template source generation, data generation, and derived source-construction generation.
scenarios.data_to_source_construction: Bind original data identity, concatenation/reparse transform, derived source identity, parser/compiler version, expression node, and final evaluator generation.
scenarios.compile_cache_source_trust: Capture compiled artifact identity/generation, source trust, cache key/entry, current policy generation, and prove the control uses the same compiler settings.
scenarios.evaluation_context_helper_object_graph: Record evaluation context generation, lexical scope, helper registry, synthetic object graph, sandbox policy, and exact expression node that executes.
scenarios.include_import_inheritance_lineage: Record that no include/import/inheritance transition participates, or bind any nested source generation explicitly to exclude hidden source promotion.
scenarios.escaping_output_downstream_state: Capture escaping policy, output context, rendered synthetic marker, read-only consumer identity, and prove no downstream active interpretation is attempted.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the exact read-only renderer/consumer that observes literal data versus evaluated marker and emits a generation-tagged deterministic receipt.
scenarios.effective_template_expression_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to inert arithmetic/string evaluation of data that should have remained a plain value in the local engine.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a read-only render receipt containing data/source generations, evaluator identity, marker result, and no process/file/network effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate principal, transaction, data generation, source transform, compiled artifact, evaluation context, evaluator, rendered marker, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold principal, template, compiler, context, helpers, output sink, and data semantics constant while changing only plain-data binding versus source reparsing.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject documented source-field semantics, mere reflection without evaluation, compiler not reached, cache generation drift, or receipt from another render transaction.
scenarios.evidence_level: TEB3 because inert arithmetic/string evaluation occurs under a generation that should have remained data-only while the read-only control stays literal.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: TEB3 maximum until a bounded reversible expression effect plus complete source/compile/context/policy provenance and remediation replay justify TEB4 or TEB5.

scenarios.hypothesis: A compiled template cache entry created under helper or sandbox policy generation N remains executable after the policy advances to N+1 and should invalidate that artifact.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A shadow policy engine, fake helper registry, and read-only render sink expose only a synthetic helper marker when the stale compiled artifact is reused.
scenarios.positive_control: A freshly recompiled artifact under policy generation N+1 follows the current helper/sandbox policy and produces the expected allowed or denied synthetic result.
scenarios.negative_control: A cache hit under an unchanged compatible policy generation remains valid, proving that the harness is testing policy-generation invalidation rather than cache use itself.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would invoke process execution, access real secrets/files, pivot network access, establish persistence, or leave the local owned sandbox.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After cache keys or invalidation bind the compiled artifact to current policy/helper generations, stale entries are recompiled and results match current policy.
scenarios.principal_source_data_generation: Record principal, transaction, source identity/trust generation, data generation, and the policy transition while keeping template semantics constant.
scenarios.data_to_source_construction: Record that source bytes and source-construction transform remain unchanged so the mismatch is isolated to compiled cache and policy-generation binding.
scenarios.compile_cache_source_trust: Bind compiler identity, compiled artifact generation, cache key/entry generation, source trust, old/new helper generations, and old/new sandbox policy generations.
scenarios.evaluation_context_helper_object_graph: Record current evaluation context, helper registry, object graph, sandbox policy, stale compiled assumptions, exact evaluator, and synthetic helper result.
scenarios.include_import_inheritance_lineage: Keep nested source lineage unchanged or record loader generations explicitly so include/import behavior cannot independently explain the stale capability.
scenarios.escaping_output_downstream_state: Use the same escaping/output context and read-only renderer for old and current policy controls, recording only an inert synthetic helper marker.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the read-only renderer that consumes the stale or fresh compiled artifact and emits the cache/policy generation receipt.
scenarios.effective_template_expression_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to one synthetic helper marker reachable under a stale compiled-policy assumption in an owner-controlled engine.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a deterministic receipt containing compiled artifact, cache entry, policy/helper generations, evaluation result, and no external effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate source, compiler, compiled generation, cache entry, old/current policy/helper generation, evaluator, marker, and renderer receipt in one record.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold source, data, evaluator, helper implementation, and renderer constant while changing only stale cached artifact versus current-policy recompilation.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject compatible policy semantics, correct cache invalidation, helper intentionally allowed in N+1, source drift, nested-loader drift, or another cache entry receipt.
scenarios.evidence_level: TEB4 because an inert synthetic helper effect is causally bound to reuse of a compiled artifact under the wrong helper/sandbox policy generation.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: TEB4 maximum until complete cache invalidation provenance, alternatives, receipts, and remediation replay satisfy the regression-verified TEB5 contract.

scenarios.hypothesis: A trusted parent template causes a lower-trust child/include to be compiled or evaluated with inherited parent trust instead of the child's independently bound trust generation.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A mock include loader and synthetic child arithmetic marker reveal nested evaluation in a read-only render sink without filesystem, network, or active-content access.
scenarios.positive_control: A child source explicitly assigned the same trusted class as the parent evaluates the marker under the documented nested-source policy.
scenarios.negative_control: The same lower-trust child independently checked under its own trust generation remains literal, denied, or capability-limited according to policy.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would invoke process execution, access real secrets/files, pivot network access, establish persistence, or leave the local owned sandbox.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After nested-source trust is independently bound at load/compile time, the lower-trust child no longer inherits parent source authority while trusted children still work.
scenarios.principal_source_data_generation: Record principal, render transaction, parent and child ownership/trust generations, source identities, and any child data generation involved.
scenarios.data_to_source_construction: Record whether child bytes are treated directly as source or derived through a loader transform, binding the transform and child compile generation.
scenarios.compile_cache_source_trust: Capture parent and child compiled artifacts, cache entries, trust classes, loader generation, policy generation, and any trust inheritance decision.
scenarios.evaluation_context_helper_object_graph: Record nested evaluation context, helper registry, object graph, sandbox policy, and exact child expression node that yields the synthetic marker.
scenarios.include_import_inheritance_lineage: Bind parent identity, child/include identity, loader, requested path, canonical resolved synthetic resource, trust generations, inheritance mode, and nested evaluator.
scenarios.escaping_output_downstream_state: Capture fixed escaping/output context and the read-only renderer that observes the child's literal/denied/evaluated marker without downstream active interpretation.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the read-only renderer that receives the nested child's result and emits a receipt naming parent/child trust and compile generations.
scenarios.effective_template_expression_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to inert child expression evaluation under inherited parent trust when independent child trust should have constrained it.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a synthetic nested-render receipt with parent/child trust generations, loader and compiled identities, marker result, and no external effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate parent, child, loader, resolved resource, trust generations, child compile artifact, nested evaluator, renderer, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold parent, child bytes, loader, evaluator, helpers, and renderer constant while changing only inherited parent trust versus independent child trust evaluation.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject intended same-trust-domain inheritance, canonicalization selecting a different child, child explicitly trusted, cache drift, or a receipt from another nested render.
scenarios.evidence_level: TEB3 because a read-only nested renderer observes inert child expression evaluation under an inappropriate inherited source-trust generation.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: TEB3 maximum until a bounded nested capability effect plus complete loader/trust/cache provenance and remediation replay justify TEB4 or TEB5.

scenarios.hypothesis: A template evaluation context uses helper-registry generation N+1 while compiled or policy assumptions still correspond to N, exposing a newly registered synthetic helper outside the documented contract.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A fake helper registry exposes only a fixed-string synthetic helper and a controlled read-only renderer records whether the helper becomes reachable.
scenarios.positive_control: An explicitly authorized template/context under helper generation N+1 can call the synthetic helper and receives the expected fixed marker.
scenarios.negative_control: A restricted template/context bound to generation N or an updated deny policy cannot resolve the synthetic helper and produces the expected denied/literal control.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would invoke process execution, access real secrets/files, pivot network access, establish persistence, or leave the local owned sandbox.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After helper registry and evaluation-policy generations are bound together, restricted contexts cannot resolve the new helper while explicitly authorized contexts still can.
scenarios.principal_source_data_generation: Record principal/tenant, render transaction, source trust generation, template source identity, data generation, and helper-registry transition from N to N+1.
scenarios.data_to_source_construction: Keep source construction unchanged and record the exact helper-call expression node so data-to-source promotion cannot independently explain the capability.
scenarios.compile_cache_source_trust: Bind compiled artifact/cache generation, source trust, assumed helper registry generation, policy generation, and whether recompilation or invalidation should occur.
scenarios.evaluation_context_helper_object_graph: Capture evaluation context, lexical scope, helper registry N/N+1, synthetic helper identity, object graph, sandbox policy, evaluator, and fixed marker result.
scenarios.include_import_inheritance_lineage: Record no nested-source transition or keep include/import generations identical across controls to isolate helper-registry/policy binding.
scenarios.escaping_output_downstream_state: Use fixed escaping/output context and a read-only renderer that records only the synthetic helper's fixed-string marker.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the exact read-only renderer consuming the helper result and emit a receipt tagged with helper registry, policy, compiled artifact, and context generations.
scenarios.effective_template_expression_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to resolving and calling one inert fixed-string synthetic helper outside the restricted context's documented helper set.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a fixed-string marker receipt with helper/policy/context generations and no file, network, process, secret, or persistence effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate principal, source trust, compiled artifact, helper registry transition, policy generation, evaluation context, helper call, renderer, and receipt.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold source, data, compiled artifact, renderer, and helper implementation constant while changing only helper-registry/policy generation binding for the restricted context.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject intentionally exposed helper policy, different source trust, recompilation under current policy, another evaluation context, or receipt miscorrelation.
scenarios.evidence_level: TEB4 because an inert synthetic helper effect is causally bound to helper-registry generation exposure under the wrong restricted evaluation-policy context.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: TEB4 maximum until complete helper/compile/policy provenance, counterfactuals, alternatives, receipt binding, and remediation replay justify TEB5.
